clauses.feature_definition: Use all cells, with arithmetic means of vertex values for point fields. Define c from cell density normalized by its sample minimum and maximum; use 4c(1-c) as a descriptive mixing-weight field.
clauses.property_measure: Measure width along the z axis as the weighted root-mean-square distance from its weighted center.
clauses.aggregation_or_representation: Multiply the stated spatial weight by cell volume and normalize by its sum.
